$note: Knob diff ONLY over the slicer-reveal base. The base slices the CONTAINED render with a HORIZONTAL L->R clip on a per-beat scrubbed ScrollTrigger; this variant turns the axis VERTICAL (top->bottom): a luminous warm scan-line descends and the render is painted in its wake (clip-path BOTTOM-inset --sweep:1->0), on the same clean cream field, contained render + serif. Recorded 1:1 from apps/quadro/public/slide-lab/slc-v3-topdown-line-sweep.html. The family invariants are UNCHANGED and inherited from the base: cream-paper SAISEI restraint (>=55% cream), NO-PLATE (.frame backing IS --cream + eager-preload), NO video / NO WebGL, transform/opacity/clip-path on scrub ONLY, reduced-motion + narrow => static legible (slices fully open), ZERO image overlap. The engine is byte-faithful to slc-v3; these are the only knobs that differ from the horizontal base.

axis.from: horizontal L->R clip slice (clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) -> inset(0 0 0 0))
axis.meaning: THE delta. Instead of a hard vertical cut travelling left->right, a luminous warm line descends from the top edge and the render is REVEALED IN ITS WAKE downward. The vertical cousin of the horizontal architectural slice.

reveal.from: hard-edged architectural clip (sliceEase expo.out, light-line on the leading right edge)
reveal.to: line-sweep paint (paint ease 0.30,0.00,0.10,1.00; luminous --line warm scan-line on the leading bottom edge + a soft 'develop' wash band below it; --lineOn fades the line out as it reaches the bottom)
reveal.meaning: A scanner painting the render downward rather than a clean cut. The line glows (box-shadow), a develop gradient band trails just below it, and the line leaves the frame at full open.

trigger.from: per-beat scrubbed ScrollTrigger over a tall band + CSS sticky stage (start 'top top' / end 'bottom bottom'), NO ScrollTrigger pin
trigger.to: per-panel scrubbed ScrollTrigger PIN (start 'top top' / end '+=len%', pin:.pin, pinSpacing:true, scrub:0.85, anticipatePin:1) + an instant --active gate (onToggle) that forces every non-active render fully closed
trigger.meaning: Each panel pins for its arrival window; the sweep runs 0->1 within the first portion, then captions resolve, then it holds before unpin. The --active gate keeps ZERO-OVERLAP immune to scrub lag at the pin hand-off seams. (The HERO is a one-time autoplay line-sweep on load, NOT pinned.)

serif.meaning: Serif family is UNCHANGED from the base — Fraunces display + Inter meta. Recorded as in slc-v3.

sweepEase.meaning: The line-sweep reveal ease — decelerates into the bottom edge, no jerky crawl. Distinct from the base's expo.out horizontal slice ease.

scrub.meaning: ScrollTrigger scrub on each pinned panel sweep — smoothing only, buttery on reverse too. (Base uses 0.8 on its sticky-stage per-beat timelines.)

panelLen.unit: % of viewport scroll the panel stays pinned
panelLen.meaning: Per-panel pin length (end '+=len%'). The SHOWPIECE climax pins longest (165%) so its line lingers and the render breathes UP. Byte-faithful to slc-v3.

kbParallax.meaning: Per-panel micro-parallax start->end scale on the painted render (transform-origin 50% 38%, world-space static). The showpiece settles to 1.045 (still breathing) for the climax; others settle to 1.0.
